newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Jan insurance premiums jump 23.7 pct - Susep.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Jan insurance premiums jump 23.7 pct - Susep.

text.p: Premiums at Brazilian insurance companies climbed 23.65 percent in January to 1.4 billion reais ($1.32 billion) versus the same month 1996, said the country's insurance watchdog Susep.
Insurance claims jumped 29.84 percent to 844.2 million reais in January compared to January 1996, it said.
Sao Paulo state accounted for 50 percent of all premiums, it added.
Susep figures differ from those released by the National Federation of Insurance Companies (Fenaseg) because there are not inflation-adjusted.
Fensaseg reported Wednesday that Brazil insurance premiums rose 18.7 percent to 1.5 billion reais in January on a year-to-year basis.
